profile_text.body:
Splice, headquartered in New York, NY, describes itself as the industry's highest quality royalty-free sample library, offering access to millions of sounds made by top artists, labels, and sound designers. The company's catalog includes samples, sound effects, and presets, and it partners with third parties such as Xfer Records, whose wavetable synthesizer it hosts with added features and workflow enhancements. Splice also offers a plugin called the Sounds Plugin that integrates directly into a digital audio workstation, allowing users to search, preview, and drag and drop samples without leaving their project.

Beyond the desktop experience, Splice provides a mobile application described as Splice Mobile, which lets users discover and record song ideas on the go and export stems to a DAW or share them with collaborators. The company also offers free, pro-grade presets along with recurring free drops each month. The held facts note a product entry that associates Splice with mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and GoPro ownership, though the company's own site focuses squarely on audio samples and music production tools.

The held facts record 299 legal exposure entries tied to New York, though no specific cases are listed in the available data. No MCP server registrations or SEC or patent filings are noted for the company.
